reference.source: Ananthanarayan and Paniker's Textbook of Microbiology (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Pili mediate attachment while IgA protease and antigenic variation dodge mucosa; lipooligosaccharide endotoxin triggers DIC purpura, and meningococcal capsule resists complement until opsonised by vaccine antibody.
additionalDifferentials: Gonococcal versus chlamydial urethritis by discharge and inclusions
Meningococcaemia versus viral exanthem by non blanching purpura
DGI versus reactive arthritis by pustules and cultures
additionalInvestigations: Urethral Gram stain with Thayer-Martin culture and NAAT
Blood cultures with CSF Gram stain and latex / PCR
Complement CH50 workup after recurrent neisserial disease
